##### Project general facts 

Green Field is a thoughtfully designed residential development that introduces a calm and refined approach to modern urban living. Located in Al Warsan, the project combines contemporary architecture, greenery, and flexible living spaces to create a balanced lifestyle environment. The development features innovative convertible residences that can transform from one-bedroom to two-bedroom homes and from two-bedroom to three-bedroom residences, offering homeowners the freedom to adapt their living space as their lifestyle evolves. Designed with a focus on comfort, simplicity, and elegance, the project provides a serene alternative to the fast pace of the city while remaining closely connected to major destinations. 

Residents enjoy a range of lifestyle amenities that bring relaxation, recreation, and social connection into everyday life. Beautifully designed leisure areas include an adult swimming pool, children’s pool, and jacuzzi, creating perfect spaces for relaxation and family time. Additional amenities such as an outdoor gym, indoor fitness center, BBQ area, sunken seating spaces, pool deck, outdoor cinema, and children’s play areas provide opportunities for entertainment and wellbeing for all ages. These thoughtfully planned facilities create a welcoming community atmosphere where leisure, health, and comfort naturally come together. 

The residences are designed with modern interiors that emphasize flexibility, elegance, and functionality. Clean architectural lines, spacious layouts, and carefully selected materials create bright and comfortable living spaces filled with natural light. Kitchens are designed with contemporary finishes and practical layouts that combine style with everyday convenience, while living areas are crafted to feel both refined and welcoming. Soft color palettes, elegant surfaces, and thoughtful design details give every home a calm, sophisticated character that supports a relaxed and enjoyable lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Warsan 4 offers a gently evolving neighbourhood where the city's constant motion gives way to a gentler pace, creating an environment that feels increasingly rare in a metropolis that never slows down. This thoughtfully planned community is framed by the natural beauty of Dubai Safari Park and the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary, with interconnected parks, shaded pathways, and open spaces that weave nature seamlessly into everyday life. From the still waters of Warsan Lake to wide parks and tree-lined green corridors, the neighbourhood wraps nature beautifully around daily living, softening the city's edges and turning home into a place residents are always drawn back to.

Life within Warsan 4 is defined by its community-centric design, with walkable neighbourhoods, unfenced parks, and integrated lifestyle spaces that foster connection and wellbeing. Anchored within the twenty-minute city framework, this is a neighbourhood that will define the city's evolution, offering lively shopping destinations, independent boutiques, neighbourhood cafes, acclaimed restaurants, and entertainment venues that place the full spectrum of city life right at your doorstep. The area's bio-diverse ecozones, including the vital wetland ecosystem of Warsan Lake, support diverse migratory and native birdlife, weaving nature into Dubai's evolving urban landscape.

The surroundings of Warsan 4 benefit from its alignment with Dubai's 2040 Green Spine vision, ensuring that the community remains at the forefront of sustainable and thoughtful urban planning. The neighbourhood's strategic location provides convenient access to key destinations while maintaining a serene and peaceful atmosphere that feels wonderfully removed from the city's relentless pace. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquility of a nature-infused community with the dynamic allure of one of the world's most exciting cities.
